versions.changelog:
- Added detailed documentation on extracting static wallpapers from Wallpaper Engine's scene.pkg files in PKGV0023/PKGV0024 formats.
- Explained binary structure for .pkg files, including header, entry metadata, and data section.
- Described method to extract all embedded PNG mipmaps from .tex texture files.
- Included step-by-step workflow for running extraction, identifying the main wallpaper, and delivering results.
- Clarified key implementation details like file offsets and naming conventions for output images.

- Initial release of the Wallpaper Engine static wallpaper extraction skill.
- Extracts PNG images (including all mipmap levels) from PKGV0023/PKGV0024 scene.pkg files.
- Parses the binary file structure to recover all embedded resources and texture images.
- Scans .tex files for multiple embedded PNGs and saves each mipmap resolution separately.
- Outputs the main wallpaper and additional textures for user delivery.
